name: Lihuayi Weiyuan Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Lihuayi Weiyuan Chemical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiary, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of polymer materials, fine chemicals, and other products in China. The company offers phenol, acetone, bisphenol A, polycarbonate, PC modified alloy materials, isopropanol, dimethyl carbonate, propylene, propylene oxide, hydrogen peroxide, and electrolyte solvents. It also provides liquid oxygen, argon, and nitrogen products. Lihuayi Weiyuan Chemical Co., Ltd. was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Dongying, China.
